notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: סור (infinitive) i askim wanpela bilong ol komand — Tok Pisin i laikim ⟨em⟩ bilong klinim

notes.subject: ארבע פעלים
notes.rationale: Fo-pela kain bilong rong (חטא, עוה, רשע, מרד) i kamap wanbilihain — drums bilong pasin sori, Tok Pisin i ken holim pasin tasol

translation: Mipela i mekim rong, na mipela i go kromap, na mipela i wokim rong tru, na mipela i ken long yu, na mipela i tanim het na lusim ⟨em⟩ — ol komand bilong yu na ol kot bilong yu.

tokens.gloss: na mipela i wokim rong tru
na mipela i ken long yu
na mipela i tanim het na lusim
